items.summary: Maintain three scaffold candidates as private, preview-only, and launch-blocked. Do not create queue work, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, or add dependencies. Use one reusable readiness-packet template covering site brief, template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance, security, owner, rollback, and launch gate. Strongest candidate is complicated.work; its single next step is to attach the dated readiness packet to the existing work item.
